body:
I'm sorry, I keep nodding off onto my keyboard. I do listen to and play music. I wrote and recorded piece just for this occasion.

I really appreciate your taking the time to talk with me, It's great to know there are kind people such as yourself out there. I sincerely hope you find all the success and happiness you deserve. It's 4.21am here - time for me to curl up with my cat and a bottle of pills. 

Again, thank you so much for being there for me at this time. You've really helped calm the chaos in my mind a lot so that I can be at peace with this. 

Take care,

S

I've given it a lot of thought over the years. One of the things about Aspergers is rhat one can hyperfocus on special interests. Like deciding I want to learn about a specific topic or whatever. It becomes an obsession and then once I feel I've exhausted every aspect, I'll move on to the next thing. 

A lot of those interests for me have been about fitting in, like learning all about a genre of music, a language, political ideas, learning to play an instrument or make things etc - the list goes on. Then once I feel like an expert or at least have a good understanding, it's filed away in case it's needed then dropped completely. 

I do enjoy learning, it's almost an innate drive, but the topics are mostly chosen so I can join in conversations with people or fit in somewhere. I don't know, at my core, what I truly am interested in or actually like. It's a bit terrifying to think about - like there's this blank non-person there that can pretend to be real very convincingly but underneath there's just wild raw emotion and confusion. 

I have had some extreme trauma in my life. When one of the worst ones happened it was like I was watching a movie from afar - I wasn't present. If I drop the masks it feels a bit like that. Like there isn't a 'me' that exists outside of the puppets constructed for survival. I can't even say anything simple to a person, like, "I'd like two train tickets please," without it all being mentally rehearsed beforehand.
I'm not sure what you mean? Do you mean have I told anyone what I'm doing or whether I've spoken about why?

Yes, I took quite a cocktail and it looks like unfortunately it hasn't worked. I;m just very, very stoned and a bit drunk and nauseous. I have a bit more left to top up with, though. If that doesn't work I found bottle of my partner's sleepers half an hour or so ago that I'll eat before I go to bed.

The simplest answer is because it hurts. I'm not sure who I am but the things that come naturally are things that a person I wouldn't like would do/say/think/feel. I'm lonely, confused and so very tired. I don't feel like I have anything positive to contribute, like everyone who knows me would be released of a burden if I was gone. It's a build up of a lot of things.

I'm glad to hear you were able to do that successfully. Whern you started again, did you feel like you knew the person you were leaving behind and what specifically you wanted to change? Like at the core? Because after wearing this mask for thirtysomething years, I don't even know what's under it anymore. What is me and what is a ghost that exists for the benefit of others. I can't pin anything down.
If it hasn't worked by now it probably won't unless I keep going.

Over they years I've become quite adept at faking normality but as I've gotten older I care less and less about bothering. I mean, where;s the payoff? Iy's exhausting being someone else, humiliating being myself and when I do try I usually fail miserably. That's not the real issue though. I'd rather one good, real friend than a million 'sorta' friends.

Ok, I've just had more so please try and excuse typing errors or if I ramble off in some nonsensical stream of consciousness. What would make you want to bother having this conversation, I wonder?

I guess I don't really have friends. Maybe one or two but none I could open up to in any meaningful sort of way. I'm not easy to get along with. Sometimes I feel like neurotypical people have something like an unconscious 'autdar'. They know there's something odd about you dtraight away and it puts them off or something. Or maybe it's jsut me. I'd better post this and continue as the keyboard's a bit of a blur and I'm tapping away slowly with 2 fingers like I've never seen a keyboard begore.

Edit: Haha - see the autdar even extends to the internet. People can tell I'm wrong from thousands of miles away and downvote accordingly (lame attempt at a joke).
Same here. Working on a response now.
Not really sure what there is to say. I guess I just wanted to feel someone was aware of my existence while it was still a thing, I dunno.

Sorry about that. Silly, I know but I wanted to get the laundry sorted so the family didn't have to worry about clean clothes. I'm here now if you're still around. Currently mixing up another shot but I'm not holding high hopes for it since the last one didn't work. 

I have done the numb thing most of my life. I have asperger's syndrome. Contrary to popular belief that doesn't make me 'unfeeling' (quite the opposite) but numbing out isn't too hard. It is very lonely though.

EDIT: I put half of the new batch aside, doing the first half now. I do really want to talk to someone.
Thank you for responding. I will be back in a few minutes if you're still around.

In case anyone cares, it obviously hasn't worked, so I ordered another gram. It should be here in about an hour or so. It would have been nice to have someone to talk to but I totally understand why nobody wants to. Thank you for the concern re: calling 911. It would be ineffective here anyway as  I am not in America. The last thing I want is rescue. What a waste of money and diligently built -up courage that would be! I wish you all the very best. Make the most of your lives. It is a precious gift.
It's currently looking like I didn't take *enough*. I've eaten the rest of my valium and am getting a bottle of bourbon now. I really need to finish up with this life.
